Include only drivers who missed fewer than three races in a given year and who switched teams between their appearances immediately before and after their hiatus (i.e., the constructor ID for the race right before their first missed race must be different from the constructor ID for the race right after their last missed race in that year). sql:
-- Final query: overall average first_round and last_round for qualifying driver-year instances
WITH hiatuses AS (
    SELECT year, driver_id, first_round, last_round
    FROM drives
    WHERE constructor_id = -1
),
prev_drives AS (
    SELECT h.year, h.driver_id, h.first_round, h.last_round,
           d.constructor_id as prev_constructor
    FROM hiatuses h
    JOIN drives d ON d.year = h.year 
        AND d.driver_id = h.driver_id 
        AND d.constructor_id != -1
        AND d.last_round = h.first_round - 1
),
next_drives AS (
    SELECT h.year, h.driver_id, h.first_round, h.last_round,
           d.constructor_id as next_constructor
    FROM hiatuses h
    JOIN drives d ON d.year = h.year 
        AND d.driver_id = h.driver_id 
        AND d.constructor_id != -1
        AND d.first_round = h.last_round + 1
),
qualifying AS (
    SELECT p.year, p.driver_id, p.first_round, p.last_round, 
           p.prev_constructor, n.next_constructor,
           (p.last_round - p.first_round + 1) as races_missed
    FROM prev_drives p
    JOIN next_drives n ON n.year = p.year AND n.driver_id = p.driver_id
    WHERE (p.last_round - p.first_round + 1) < 3
      AND p.prev_constructor != n.next_constructor
)
SELECT 
    AVG(1.0 * first_round) as avg_first_round,
    AVG(1.0 * last_round) as avg_last_round
FROM qualifying
